# Arca MCP tool map

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_tool_map.py from api/mcp/catalog.rs. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every tool is prefixed `afssr_` (a kept wire-level name). `path` takes the ids in `{braces}`;
`query` takes filters; writes also take `body`, `dry_run` (default true) and `confirmation`.
Impact decides the approval you need: **Read** is free; **Change** needs preview + confirmation;
**External** and **Destructive** additionally need an explicit human go-ahead for that specific action.

172 operations, plus `afssr_identity`. `tools/list` only shows what your role and key scopes permit.

## Feedback, diagnostics and offline checks

| Tool | Method and path | Impact | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `afssr_compatibility_list` | `GET /api/admin/compatibility` | Read | Read offline synthetic protocol profiles and results, configuration fingerprints and stale markers. |
| `afssr_compatibility_profile_save` | `POST /api/admin/compatibility/profiles` | Change | Save a bounded offline compatibility profile only. |
| `afssr_compatibility_run` | `POST /api/admin/compatibility/runs` | Change | Run and persist the fixed offline synthetic protocol suite only; no transport, provider keys, paid models or real clients. |
| `afssr_benefits_preview` | `POST /api/admin/access-preview` | Read | Read effective user model access and current or proposed USD entitlements without saving or sending inference. |
| `afssr_request_diagnostics` | `GET /api/admin/monitoring/diagnostics/{request_id}` | Read | Read allowlisted request stage evidence and a safe diagnostic summary. |
| `afssr_leaderboard_overview` | `GET /api/admin/stats/leaderboard/overview` | Read | Read internal usage rankings, model popularity, estimated active minutes, hourly leaders, early birds (first success from 06:00) and night owls ... |
| `afssr_feedback_list` | `GET /api/admin/feedback` | Read | List all user feedback issues. |
| `afssr_feedback_get` | `GET /api/admin/feedback/{issue_id}` | Read | Read a feedback issue including visibility(public/private, default private), current version and authorized event history. |
| `afssr_feedback_create` | `POST /api/admin/feedback` | Change | Create feedback owned by the current authenticated administrator, never a caller-supplied owner. |
| `afssr_feedback_command` | `POST /api/admin/feedback/{issue_id}/commands` | Change | Reply or resolve/close/reopen with current actual administrator authority and feedback write scope. |

## Users, groups, keys and benefits

| `afssr_users_batch_action` | `POST /api/admin/users/batch-action` | Destructive | Apply an existing batch action with selection, action and payload; administrator protections still apply. |
| `afssr_users_sessions` | `GET /api/admin/users/{user_id}/sessions` | Read | List a user's login devices and sessions. |
| `afssr_users_revoke_sessions` | `DELETE /api/admin/users/{user_id}/sessions` | Destructive | Revoke all login sessions for a user. |
| `afssr_users_revoke_session` | `DELETE /api/admin/users/{user_id}/sessions/{session_id}` | Destructive | Revoke one login session. |
| `afssr_users_keys` | `GET /api/admin/users/{user_id}/api-keys` | Read | List user inference-key metadata, never plaintext keys. |
| `afssr_users_create_key` | `POST /api/admin/users/{user_id}/api-keys` | Change | Create a user inference key. |
| `afssr_users_update_key` | `PUT /api/admin/users/{user_id}/api-keys/{key_id}` | Change | Change inference-key model/provider/format restrictions and limits. |
| `afssr_users_delete_key` | `DELETE /api/admin/users/{user_id}/api-keys/{key_id}` | Destructive | Delete a user's inference key. |
| `afssr_groups_list` | `GET /api/admin/user-groups` | Read | List user groups. |
| `afssr_groups_create` | `POST /api/admin/user-groups` | Change | Create a group with name, description and model access settings. |
| `afssr_groups_update` | `PUT /api/admin/user-groups/{group_id}` | Change | Update user-group settings and model policy. |
| `afssr_groups_delete` | `DELETE /api/admin/user-groups/{group_id}` | Destructive | Delete a user group; existing default-group protections apply. |
| `afssr_benefits_get` | `GET /api/admin/system/configs/internal_access_policy` | Read | Read total USD budgets, exact-model sub-pools and explicit model_families definitions with allocation.families shared sub-pools. |
| `afssr_benefits_set` | `PUT /api/admin/system/configs/internal_access_policy` | Change | Set benefits with body {value, expected_value} from last read. |

| `afssr_keys_create` | `POST /api/admin/api-keys` | Change | Create a standalone inference key; any returned secret is redacted. |
| `afssr_keys_update` | `PUT /api/admin/api-keys/{key_id}` | Change | Update standalone inference-key restrictions and limits. |
| `afssr_keys_delete` | `DELETE /api/admin/api-keys/{key_id}` | Destructive | Delete a standalone inference key. |

## Approval by impact

| Impact | Needs |
| --- | --- |
| Read | none |
| Change | preview + confirm |
| External | preview + confirm + **human OK** (uses stored credentials / contacts a target, may cost money) |
| Destructive | preview + confirm + **human OK** |
